company_news.headline: Cintas (CTAS) Stock May Look Rich On Strong Cash Flow Expectations
company_news.summary: Cintas stock has delivered strong long term gains over the past five years, yet current valuation checks now suggest the shares are priced at a premium rather than offering clear value. With the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate sitting close to the market price while market multiples lean expensive, investors have mixed signals to weigh.
